title: Electrical Engineer
description:
What's the role?

As an Electrical engineer at RYBKA, you will provide high-quality electrical building-services engineering and project delivery, from concept through to construction and handover. The role will involve developing technically robust, coordinated and commercially viable electrical designs that meet the client's requirements, statutory obligations and relevant industry standards, while supporting the successful delivery of projects to programme and budget.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop electrical building-services designs from concept through to detailed design and construction.
  • Prepare electrical calculations, schematics, layouts, specifications and schedules.
  • Design LV distribution, lighting, small power, fire detection and alarm, emergency lighting, communications, security and other electrical building-services systems as appropriate to the project.
  • Undertake electrical load assessments, cable calculations, voltage-drop calculations, fault-level assessments and protective-device coordination.
  • Ensure designs comply with relevant British Standards, statutory requirements, CIBSE guidance, Scottish Building Standards and project-specific requirements.
  • Coordinate electrical designs with mechanical, architectural, structural and civil engineering disciplines.
  • Review and technically assess contractor proposals, design submissions and technical queries.
  • Validate the commissioning process to ensure all products and services implemented meet the required specifications.
  • Advise on the operating and maintenance manuals produced by contractors to support the services installed.
  • Ensure the effective handover of the project from the contractor and ensure the final construction meets the agreed requirements and design intent.
  • Assist in conducting a review of H&S and risk assessments under the Construction Design and Management Regulations and sign off compliance with these regulations.
  • Maintain up to date industry knowledge of products and services to ensure the client always receives the best advice


What we’re looking for:
  • Degree qualified in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Building Services Engineering with an appropriate electrical bias, or a closely related discipline is essential
  • Demonstrable commitment to professional development and progression towards IEng or CEng, as appropriate.
  • Working towards or holding professional membership of an appropriate engineering institution, e.g. IET or CIBSE. desirable
  • Incorporated Engineer (IEng) or Chartered Engineer (CEng) status is desirable
  • Competent user of relevant electrical design software, including AutoCAD and electrical calculation/design packages such as Amtech, Trimble
  • ProDesign or equivalent. Experience with DIALux, Relux, Revit and/or BIM coordination would be advantageous. Experience of substantial, complex construction projects.
  • Experience delivering electrical building-services design on medium to large-scale construction projects, ideally within a multidisciplinary consultancy environment.
  • Experience of projects through multiple RIBA stages, from feasibility/concept through detailed design, tender, construction and handover.
  • Experience of operating in an ISO9001 Quality Management System

Essential technical skills
  • LV electrical distribution
  • Lighting and emergency lighting
  • Small power
  • Cable sizing and voltage drop
  • Fault-level calculations
  • Protective-device selection and discrimination
  • Earthing and bonding
  • Fire alarm systems
  • Electrical containment
  • Electrical specifications and schedules
  • Building-services coordination
  • BS 7671 and relevant British Standards

Desirable
  • Generators and UPS systems
  • PV and battery energy storage
  • EV charging
  • Lightning protection
  • BMS/controls
  • Energy/carbon assessments
  • Low-carbon electrical design
  • Healthcare electrical systems
  • Data centres / critical systems


About The Organisation

RYBKA, part of the BRUSH Group, is a multi-disciplined engineering consultancy practice that specialise in mechanical, electrical and public health (MEP) projects in the built environment. With offices based across Scotland, RYBKA are recognised for their environmentally friendly projects and cost-effective engineering with has led to them being awarded multiple Scottish Design Awards.

With a proven track record of delivering projects across the UK since 1930, RYBKA specialises in transport, hospitality, healthcare, education, commercial and defence. Key projects including – Dunfermline Learning Campus, East Lothian Community Hospital, Royal Edinburgh Hospital, Edinburgh Airport Terminal Expansion and Village Hotels.
